sections.h2: Three-quarters of pharma exports grew 0.7 per cent in FY26

chart.title: Vaccines grew fastest while formulations, the bulk of exports, barely moved
chart.sub: Export growth by category, FY2025-26 over the prior year, %.

sections.means: Drug formulations were about three-quarters of the $31.1 billion export book and grew 0.7 per cent, so that one line carried the year.
sections.todo: Read the category split alongside the headline total next year, because the total hides the formulations line.

sections.h2: The US share of pharma exports fell from 34.5 to 30.44 per cent

chart.title: The US share lost about 4 points of exports in a single year
chart.sub: Share of India's pharma export value going to the United States, %.

sections.means: The FY25 figure was itself inflated by roughly a $1.6 billion pre-buy ahead of feared tariffs.
sections.todo: Watch the US line month by month, since March 2026 alone fell 23 per cent and carried the shortfall.

sections.h2: China supplies 94.1 per cent of 6-APA, a penicillin intermediate

chart.title: Import dependence on China is deepest in antibiotic intermediates
chart.sub: Share of imports sourced from China, %.

sections.means: China supplies 70 per cent or more of 97 distinct active ingredients, so the dependence is broad as well as deep.
sections.todo: Ask for the FY26 import data to test whether the 43.45 per cent China share has moved.

sections.h2: The bulk-drug PLI has sold ₹2,720 crore against a ₹6,940 crore outlay

chart.title: The bulk-drug scheme has substituted ₹2,192 crore of imports so far
chart.sub: Bulk Drugs PLI, cumulative to December 2025, ₹ crore.

sections.means: Against a ₹6,940 crore outlay, the bulk-drug scheme has produced ₹2,720 crore of cumulative sales.
sections.todo: Track the 38 commissioned projects to see whether substitution rises as they ramp to full capacity.
